knowledge_gaps: The history-conditioned input gate is underspecified: previous_state could require an additional sequential pass or introduce a circular dependency. Define its causal computation, padding behavior, tensor shapes, and treatment of the first valid item.

Reproduction requires vocabulary size, tokenization rules, text-length limits, embedding dimensions, gate initialization, residual scaling, and handling of missing descriptions. Masked pooling must safely return zero for empty text.

No baseline validation HR@10 or text-coverage measurements establish that lexical information is the best first intervention. The potential and difficulty ratings remain subjective; history conditioning and predictor consistency may make implementation harder than stated.

Training-position margins do not establish generalization or explain Electronics errors. Diagnostics should distinguish ID embeddings from the effective lexical representations, and mark unavailable category breakdowns as unavailable.

Text can reinforce the diagnosed brand and broad-theme shortcuts. Controlled ablations should compare the unchanged baseline, item-only lexical fusion, and history-conditioned fusion while retaining one trained model per category in each trial.

The report lacks a concrete trial allocation, stopping policy, validation frequency, and checkpoint-selection rule within the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget. Repeated selection on 200 validation users per category risks validation overfitting.
